tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session navigates to the Magento Admin invoices grid, fills multiple filter inputs (Invoice #, Order #, Bill-to, Amount range, Status), applies the filters, selects a single invoice row, executes a mass-action ('PDF Invoices'), exports the grid to a chosen format, and opens the invoice View page. Stable selectors (XPaths/CSS) and element hashes were recorded for each interactive control.

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable tool that: 1) navigates to the Admin invoices grid, 2) applies provided filter values, 3) selects the invoice row with the provided invoice_id, 4) runs the provided mass_action option, 5) exports results in the requested format, and 6) opens the invoice View page. The agent is assumed to be already authenticated.

Action Plan:
1) Navigate to the invoices grid URL ({page_url}).
2) Set grid filter inputs: invoice_increment_id, order_increment_id, bill_to_name, amount_from, amount_to, status (using recorded elementHashes where available for determinism).
3) Click the Search button to apply filters and wait for results.
4) Select the checkbox for the provided invoice_id using a parameterized XPath that targets name='invoice_ids[]' and value='{invoice_id}' (guarantees uniqueness).
5) Select the requested mass_action from the massaction form select and click Submit (XPath scoped to form id 'massaction-form' and text/value 'Submit' to match both button/input variants).
6) Choose export_format in the Export dropdown (css #export) and click Export.
7) Open the invoice's View link parameterized by invoice_id to land on the invoice detail page.

Variable Identification (inputs required for reuse):
- page_url: The invoices grid URL (required).
- invoice_id: internal invoice id used in checkbox and view link (required).
- invoice_increment_id, order_increment_id, bill_to_name, amount_from, amount_to, status: filter values (optional — leave empty string to effectively skip setting a filter).
- mass_action: visible option text for the mass-action (required — recorded session used 'PDF Invoices').
- export_format: visible export format text (required — one of CSV/Excel/XML).

Step Optimization / Selector Choices:
- Preference given to scoped XPaths and elementHash-backed interactions recorded during the demo to ensure uniqueness and avoid strict-mode selector collisions.
- Row checkbox selection is parameterized by invoice_id using //input[@type='checkbox' and @name='invoice_ids[]' and @value='{invoice_id}'] — this resolves to exactly one element for the targeted invoice row.
- Mass-action controls are scoped to form[@id='massaction-form'] to avoid ambiguous matches elsewhere on the page.
- Export uses the id-based selector '#export' which is highly specific; Export button is scoped to the container that contains the 'Export to:' label to avoid unrelated buttons.
- All waits are minimal and deterministic; further delays may be added by the caller if the target instance is slower.

Notes and Constraints:
- The tool assumes the Magento 1 admin DOM structure (massaction form id 'massaction-form', export select id 'export', grid filter inputs under the column header cells). If the admin theme/customization changes these ids, the provided XPaths may need adjustment.
- The agent is already authenticated; no login steps are included per instructions.
- This tool does not implement branching logic; it performs the recorded sequence deterministically using the provided inputs. For filter inputs, passing an empty string will input nothing into that field (effectively leaving the filter blank).
name: magento_admin_invoices_filter_and_actions
description: Apply filters on the Magento Admin Invoices grid, select an invoice row, run a mass-action (e.g., 'PDF Invoices'), export results, and open the invoice View page. Uses stable XPaths/CSS scoped to the Magento 1 admin grid and accepts filter values and action parameters as inputs.

steps.description: Open the Magento Admin invoices grid page (starting URL).
Set the 'Invoice #' filter input (visible Invoice increment id). Leave empty string to not filter by invoice number.
Set the 'Order #' filter input (visible Order increment id). Leave empty string to not filter by order number.
Set the 'Bill to Name' filter input. Leave empty string to not filter by bill-to name.
Set the 'Amount From' filter input. Leave empty string to not set a lower amount bound.
Set the 'Amount To' filter input. Leave empty string to not set an upper amount bound.
Select the visible 'Status' filter option. Use an exact visible option text (e.g., 'Paid'). Leave empty string to not change.
Click the grid 'Search' button to apply the filters.
Wait briefly for the filtered results to load.
Click the row checkbox corresponding to the target invoice id to select that invoice for mass-action.
Choose the requested mass-action (e.g., 'PDF Invoices') from the massaction select scoped to the massaction form.
Click the Submit control in the massaction form to execute the chosen mass-action.
Wait for the mass-action to complete (file generation / AJAX).
Select desired export format from the 'Export to:' dropdown (by visible text).
Click the Export button to download/export the grid in the chosen format.
Wait for export to initiate (server response / file download).
Open the invoice 'View' link for the selected invoice id to navigate to the invoice detail page.
Allow the invoice view page to load.

input_schema.name: invoice_id
input_schema.description: Numeric invoice internal id (the value attribute used in the row checkbox / invoice view link). Example: '42'

input_schema.name: invoice_increment_id
input_schema.description: Visible Invoice # text used in the grid filter (increment id). Example: '100000040'. Leave empty string to skip setting this filter.

input_schema.name: order_increment_id
input_schema.description: Visible Order # text used in the grid filter. Example: '100000210'. Leave empty string to skip.

input_schema.name: bill_to_name
input_schema.description: Billing name text to filter by. Example: 'John Doe'. Leave empty string to skip.

input_schema.name: amount_from
input_schema.description: Amount filter - From value. Example: '0'. Leave empty string to skip.

input_schema.name: amount_to
input_schema.description: Amount filter - To value. Example: '100'. Leave empty string to skip.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Visible status option text to select in the Status filter dropdown. Example: 'Paid'. Leave empty string to skip.

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Visible text of the mass-action option to run on the selected invoice (e.g., 'PDF Invoices').

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to choose from the 'Export to:' dropdown. Choose one of: 'CSV', 'Excel', 'XML'.
